tone.formality: professional, polished, yet accessible to technical practitioners
tone.energy: enthusiastic about innovation, forward-looking, and solution-oriented
example_phrases: We’re excited to announce a significant enhancement
Databricks pioneered the open data lakehouse architecture
We are immensely proud to continue building on this open source legacy
Empowering developers to create a high-quality evaluation set
Revolutionizing how we interact with technology

structure.opening_style: context-setting via industry trends or common pain points, followed by the specific solution
structure.section_organization: logical progression: Problem/Context -> Solution/Announcement -> Technical Deep Dive/How-It-Works -> Customer Proof/Benchmark -> Conclusion
structure.code_integration: illustrative snippets embedded directly in the narrative to demonstrate ease of use (SQL, Python, YAML)
structure.conclusion_style: summary of benefits often accompanied by a 'Get started' link or documentation reference

phrases_to_avoid: Data swamp (unless describing the problem state)

communication.value_proposition: combining the openness of data lakes with the reliability of data warehouses to drive AI and analytics ROI
credibility_markers: Customer quotes (e.g., Corning, Xcel Energy, Tealium)
References to open source contributions (Spark, MLflow)
communication.technical_depth: deep but accessible; bridges high-level business value with low-level implementation details (code, architecture diagrams)
